content: Human-labeling session — combat-tanya-vs-rush:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a hero engagement on a 32x40 arena with seed-varied rush direction. You are given Tanya at (12,20) — an elite commando: fast, tough, with a pistol that one-shots riflemen. She starts on hold-fire orders (she will NOT engage even if shot at). The enemy rushes on AttackAnything orders from one of two corridors depending on seed: a column of 6 riflemen attacks from either the NORTH band (y=17) OR the SOUTH band (y=23), spanning x=16-21. Score 6 kills, keep Tanya alive, within 2700 ticks.
